load_coval_metric: load the coval evaluation metric using evaluate.load("coval")
launch_gradio_widget: launch an interactive Gradio widget for the coval metric evaluation
combine_metrics: combine multiple evaluation metrics using evaluate.combine(["accuracy", "f1"])
compute_metric_results: compute coval metric results with predictions and references
list_evaluation_modules: list available evaluation modules using evaluate.list_evaluation_modules()
